questions.question:
In this question, three statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follows/follow from the statements.

**Statements:**

I. All planets are asteroids.

II. All orbits are asteroids.

III. No star is an asteroid.

**Conclusions:**

I. No planet is a star.

II. No star is an orbit.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
Given Statements :

All planets are asteroids,

All orbits are asteroids,

No star is an asteroid,

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d1da4087b1b0b2b52b664a176a3ef3e2c3ff42ae95df13524998f626d596e3c5.png] 

Conclusions :

I. No planet is a star - True ( Because, there is no definite relation between planet and star but It is possible so, it's true )

II. No star is an orbit - True ( Because, there is no definite relation between a star and orbit but It is possible so, it's true)

Thus, Both conclusions I and II follow,

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

questions.question: In a certain code language, 'FICTION' is coded as 'C70' and 'DUSTILY' is coded as 'A106'. How will 'ENDGAME' be coded in that language?
questions.solution:
The position and positional values of English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0270f2b5240d1e3915517248ac98d6d73ad611166857551401277421991a6c6e.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, FICTION is coded as C70

Sum of positional values of letters in given word:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6380552c6fa9f36a4540f784bcedd7061ff33cd08cc622d5d2c5be0fecdbd9c8.png] 

First letter of word - 3 = First letter of code 

F - 3 = C

76 - 6 = 70 (F = 6, in alphabetical series)

Assigned code to FICTION is C70.

For, DUSTILY is coded as A106.

Sum of positional values of letters in given word:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa61a6a6d63c07d769b0dade1e358cc47dbffd2999608bf1f14526db9f55f367.png] 

First letter of word - 3 = First letter of code.

D - 3 = A

110 - 4 = 106 (D = 4, in alphabetical series)

Assigned code to DUSTILY is A106.

Similarly, ENDGAME will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fcfcebfe31cb756580a2b007bdd0ba0883e874cd584dd31ed942a14c81506db7.png] 

First letter of word - 3 = First letter of code.

E - 3 = B

49 - 5 = 44 (E = 5, in alphabetical series)

Code to ENDGAME is B44.

So, ENDGAME will be coded as B44.

Hence, the correct answer is ***'Option 1'.***

questions.question:
Arrange the following words in a logical and meaningful order.

1. Tree

2. Sprout

3. Sapling

4. Seed

5. Seedling
questions.solution:
The correct logical order of given words will be:

4. Seed (Where life begins.)

2. Sprout (To Birth)

5. Seedling (Young tree)

3. Sapling (Adult tree)

1. Tree (A mature tree)

So, "4, 2, 5, 3, 1" is the correct logical order.

Hence, the correct answer is **'Option 4'**.
